basis: The six-page Flight Briefing prints a character as itself only when its faces (reportlab standard Helvetica / Helvetica-Bold, with the Symbol substitution face) draw it with a real glyph AND PyMuPDF text extraction returns it unchanged, and it is a graphic character (a letter, digit, punctuation or symbol, or the space). Measured by app/odss/pdf_printable.py measured_repertoire_ranges; tests/test_pdf_printable_20261017.py requires this file to equal the measurement.
escape: Every other character prints as [U+XXXX]: its code point in upper-case hexadecimal, at least four digits. A line break stays a line break.
